questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ _ _ B _ _ A X B _ Z
questions.solution:
Let's check all the options: 

__

• ​C X C Z B / A C A X B / A Z ​
 
• It is not logically following.
 
• **Option (2): ZAXCZC**
 
• **​C Z A X B / C Z A X B / C Z __**

• Option (3): ACXZCZ
 
• ​C A C X B / Z C A X B / Z Z
 
• It is not logically following.
 
• Option (4): CCXAZA

• It is not logically following.

​Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All sacks are rugs.

All mugs are rugs.

All pugs are rugs.

Conclusions:

(I): Some pugs are sacks.

(II): Some mugs are pugs.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fccc56aede23b2cf0c16a4596c27344334a7580c56547fe54e503f2885c9d7d.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some pugs are sacks.- False (Their is no direct relation between pugs and sacks may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): Some mugs are pugs. - False (Their is no direct relation between pugs and mugs may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'TNRA' is coded as '28' and 'LOPGVO' is coded as '42'. How is 'JDSHKQB' coded in the given language?
questions.solution:
Given : TNRA is coded as '28' and 'LOPGVO' is coded as '42'.**
**Logic: Number of letters × 7 **

 
• TNRA → 28
 
• Letters = 4
 
• **Code = 4 × 7 = 28**
 
• LOPGVO → 42
 
• Letters = 6
 
• **Code = 6 × 7 = 42**

Similarly,

 
• JDSHKQB 
 
• Letters = 7
 
• Code = 7 × 7 = 49.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**

questions.solution:
Given : DUMPERS**
Letters in DUMPERS

D, U, M, P, E, R, S

Alphabetical order:

D, E, M, P, R, S, U

Left D, E, M, P, R, S, U Right

4th from the left = P

2nd from the right = S

Now, count how many letters are in between P and S in alphabetical order.

Letters between them: Q (17), R (18)

So, total = 2 letters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**

questions.solution:

55 + 3 = 58

58 + 5 = 63

63 + 7 = 70

So, the next number is 70 + 9 = 79

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"**
